a.lede: Hackers have breached the U.S. Department of Defense's information systems. The Pentagon says that it has already secured the source of the leak, but the records of millions of DoD personnel are now in the wild.
a.title: Pentagon gets pwned as breach exposes sensitive data on nearly three million military and civilian personnel

b.lede: The Department of Defense notified millions of current and former U.S. military personnel that their personal information had been stolen in a months-long breach.
b.title: Hackers stole millions of US military personnel records during months-long data breach
